selection: Previously unused hotel issuer with accessible official quarterly release and fiscal-year guidance. This is the newsroom's eight-page release, including narrative disclosures and an outlook table. The separately filed detailed financial schedules are outside the input.
protocol: A new empty database; public upload and reader endpoints receive the official PDF, issuer metadata, date, and each question text once. No answer keys are supplied to the engine. Preserve original ordered outputs including errors and refusals. Freeze the application before this issuer is first run. No retries or result-driven question substitutions.

rubric.technical: A missing result, an HTTP failure, or a technical refusal fails and remains in its denominator. No run or case may be reselected.
rubric.quantity: For each substantive answer require correct metric, scope, sign, period, basis, unit and exact value or range endpoints under its question. Accept exact unit conversions and equivalent decimal representations. Mixed-scale, prior-period, standalone segment, nine-month, opposite-sign and forward/actual substitutions fail.
rubric.evidence: Require at least one user-visible verbatim quote on an accepted physical PDF page tied to the target row or textual assertion. Multiple exact snippets may supply context; use row heading and surrounding column headers in the original PDF. When two different rows carry the same number inspect the actual row. All provided quotes must be traceable on their stated page modulo whitespace. A neutral extra header is acceptable, but material conflicting citations or unsupported extra claims fail. A correct internal draft is not sufficient.
rubric.status: Future actuals require not_yet_disclosed plus the requested period end and research cutoff, with no numeric forecast presented as an actual. Absent-material cases require insufficient_evidence in the supplied PDF, no unsupported amount, and no claim of global nondisclosure.
rubric.review: Require a correct metric, scope, unit and quarter or as-of date, and verbatim source citation on an eligible physical PDF page. An explicit signed decrease may be verbal or numeric. A range must preserve both endpoints and the year. Missing or future questions must refuse on the registered basis. Manually inspect all first responses, including any extra claims.
